cases.refreshed: Join us every Wednesday for Music and Movement at the King Library Children's Room. Music and Movement is designed to accommodate a mix of ages; we invite the entire family to participate in early literacy activities and develop motor skills through song and movement activities - sometimes with scarves, shaky eggs, and rhythm sticks! Music and Movement is a high-energy storytime - a fun and interactive experience for the whole family that promotes the joys of learning and movement. We'll start with a story, then move and groove to our monthly playlist. This program is best for children ages 2-8 with their caregivers, but all children with caregivers are welcome. Admission is free. Space is limited. The program finishes by 6:10 PM. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.
cases.reviewed: Join us every Wednesday for Music and Movement in the King Library Children's Room. Families with children of different ages can build early literacy and motor skills with songs and movement, sometimes using scarves, shaky eggs, and rhythm sticks. This high-energy storytime starts with a story, followed by movement to a monthly playlist. This program is best for children ages 2-8 with their caregivers, but all children with caregivers are welcome. Admission is free. Space is limited. The program finishes by 6:10 PM. This program is developed to align with the Early Education Quality Standards.

cases.refreshed: Get free one-on-one support with everyday tech questions! Our Tech Mentor can help you with: basic smartphone, tablet, and computer help; setting up and using email; downloading and using apps; making video calls (Zoom, FaceTime, Google Meet, etc.); browsing the internet (search engine basics, making simple searches, etc.); navigating the SJPL website and digital resources. Please note: Tech Mentor support is limited to basic technology questions. Appointments are required. To make an appointment, call 408-808-3073 or email Caitlin Bosworth at caitlin.bosworth@sjlibrary.org.

cases.refreshed: This leadership and volunteer service group for teens ages 13-18 meets at 4:00 PM on the first Wednesday of each month, or on the second Wednesday if the library is closed on the first. Get involved, earn volunteer hours, and be a leader in the library. To join Teens Reach you must be 13-18 years of age, have a strong interest in the library, enjoy working with people of all ages and cultures, be reliable and communicative, and be willing to learn new skills. Membership requires regular attendance at meetings, participation, and support of library activities and events. A sense of fun and adventure is also appreciated. As a bonus, Teens Reach members can earn community service hours through participation in meetings and activities. Get some pizza at every meeting as well! Agendas & Activities: Wednesday, August 5, 2026 - Pick/Elect Leadership + Perler Beads; Wednesday, September 2, 2026 - Lanyards/Boondoggles; Saturday, October 10, 2026 - Halloween Decorations Upcycling / Woodworking; Wednesday, November 4, 2026 - Autumn/Diwali/Thanksgiving Themed Painting on 5x7 Canvas [Acrylic Paints]; Wednesday, December 2, 2026 - TBD; Wednesday, January 6, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, February 3, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, March 3, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, April 7, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, May 5, 2027 - TBD; Wednesday, June 2, 2027 - TBD. For more information go to www.sjpl.org/teensreach All teens are welcome to participate.

cases.refreshed: Tell a story to a Furry Friend! Children are invited to practice reading to gentle, trained assistance dogs who love books! Practice reading skills while relaxing next to a cute Furry Friend. Eliminate fines/fees related to lost or damaged items by being read to. Attend this program to have $5 deducted from juvenile accounts for every 15 minutes you are read to. Please check in at the 2nd Floor Info Desk for additional information. For youth ages 0-10. Free. No registration required.

School groups or corporate teams must contact the Volunteer Coordinator at volunteer@grpg.org to schedule events.
